name: Spexl
summary: Spexl is an incremental game where you destroy planets made of pixels and collect every particle they’re made of to upgrade your ship. Fly, shoot, and get back to base before you run out of fuel. The challenge is to push farther and farther out.

name: Moonbow Idle: Dark Fantasy Auto Battler

similar_games.name: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree

name: City Transport Manager
summary: City Transport Manager is a public transport management simulation in which players build and run the bus, tram and subway network of any city or village in the world. Every map is generated from real map data, including the actual streets, landmarks, shops, schools and stations. Players place stops, draw lines with a few taps and set service frequencies and operating hours. As the company grows, tram tracks, an underground metro network on its own layer, larger depots and vehicles ranging from minibuses to articulated and double-decker buses in custom liveries become available. Every passenger has a real destination, and waiting time, travel time and crowding determine their satisfaction. The management side covers ticket revenue, subsidies and loans, research, objectives and collectible cards. The game is developed by PeDePe, the studio behind City Bus Manager.

name: WORKS: Motorsport Factory
summary: A tycoon game about building a racing factory from your garage. Scavenge, buy or design your own parts, fix cars, and climb every tier of motorsport. Balancing tight finances and decaying parts forces hard calls: repairs, upgrades, or paying the debts to keep the team alive.

similar_games.name: Milk Outside a Bag of Milk Outside a Bag of Milk
Lackgirl I: Astra Inclinant, sed Non Obligant.

name: Beekeeper Simulator
summary: Beekeeper Simulator puts you in the shoes of a dedicated beekeeper, where you'll care for buzzing hives, harvest a variety of honey types, and expand your operations to build a thriving beekeeping empire. Nurture your bees, optimize your apiary, and turn your passion into profit!

name: Code Market
summary: Your store. Your robot. Your code. Code Market is a relaxed management game where you don't click to sell — you program. A robot works in your supermarket, and it does exactly what your Java code tells it: walk to a rack, pick up tomatoes, take a customer's order, pack the bag.

name: Needle in a Haystack Simulator in a Haystack of Needle in a Haystack Simulators
summary: 5,000,000 games on VAPOR, and all but one are clones. From your bedroom PC, screen procedurally generated store pages, stamp each fake on the detail that gives it away, put bots to work, and dig through the haystack for the one original. An incremental hidden object parody.

name: Piscis
summary: Piscis is a small 8-bit arcade-style game where you play as a small fish trying to navigate through an ocean brimming with junk, fishing nets, and hooks. Avoid a barrage of falling obstacles and traverse through colourful level backdrops, alongside an original chiptune soundtrack!

name: Flee, Fair Light!
summary: The Light has awoken a terrible Darkness... Play as a monster with a bloodlust for brilliance and catch the Light in this 1-bit arcade style game! The Light will attempt to flee from you through a labyrinthine set of winding paths and use every tool at its disposal to flee from you, slyly stopping you in your tracks as it too navigates this strange maze it now finds itself in. Capture the Light in your deadly claws, lest it escape from you!

name: PatriotQuest
storyline: DARK REAGAN has taken hold of the United States government and is sapping the patriotic power out of the country to power his evil reign! Are you a tough enough dude to defeat DARK REAGAN and save the United States of America?

name: The Burrow Massacre
storyline: You have been kidnapped by a maniac who has taken you to his lair... Can you survive the night and escape "The Burrow"?

name: Sage: Psychic Spy
summary: A stealth action-adventure game where your mind is your weapon. Play as Sage, a psychic spy investigating a new drug cartel in Krad City. Sneak deep into enemy territory, read minds to gain intel, and use telekinesis to manipulate your enemies and environment.

name: Gardariki: Call of the Soul

similar_games.name: Sword of Destruction II: Kyouhen no Yakata

storyline:
Long before the events of the main game, three stories unfold in the ancient Slavic world of Gardariki. Each of them follows a different heroine: Emer, Vasilisa, and Morevna.

Each heroine faces her own challenges. Emer wants to choose her own future despite the expectations of those around her. She must find a balance between reason and feelings. Vasilisa seeks to uncover the mysteries of life and death, but her thirst for knowledge may lead her too far. Morevna has a special gift that allows her to sense the pain and fear of others. She helps people overcome their worries, yet sometimes struggles to understand her own feelings.

These three stories explore fate, human emotions, and the consequences of choice, revealing more about the world of Gardariki. Through dialogue and important decisions, players get to know the heroines and influence the course of their stories, shaping the paths they will take.

name: Slug Thug
summary:
Slug Thug is an online cartoon life simulator played in a web browser on PC and phones. Starting out with a backyard, the player works their way up to a mansion in the hills by growing and crossbreeding strains in a garden and greenhouse, selling to customers on the street, and dodging the police.

Between hustles, players can drift customizable cars on tracks ranging from a neon city to a mountain pass, skate at a seaside park, play a 20-machine arcade and a play-money casino, and dress up with tattoos, haircuts, clothes and jewelry. Every player shares the same streets, with chat, buddy calls, duels and home visits. The game is intended for adults 21 and over.

name: Math Duck+
summary: Math Duck+ is a puzzle‑platformer where you must collect the correct numbered blocks to complete each equation while avoiding hazards and racing against the clock. Solve all the equations to reveal the key, then grab it and reach the exit before time runs out.

name: Somebody's Home: The Boarding House

similar_games.name: The House in Fata Morgana: A Requiem for Innocence

storyline: 1980. You rent a room in a boarding house on a quiet street. Dinner is at eight sharp, and Theodora, the old woman who runs the place, tells you that here you're not a guest: you're family. She tends the garden herself, and she only asks one thing of you: never step into it without telling her first. By day the house is warm. At night it's something else.
summary: 1980. Rooms to let on a quiet street, meals included, a landlady who calls her lodgers family. You move into one. And as the days pass, you cannot shake the feeling that something in that house is wrong, and that it has been wrong for a very long time. A first-person psychological horror story.

name: Mossnaso
summary: Disintegrate enemies to fill the curly gauge but don’t let your wavy gauge become depleted because you’d die.

name: Pokémon Banished Platinum
summary: A fan made remake of Pokémon Platinum that preserves the story, locations and characters of the original game while adding Mega Evolutions, regional forms, gen 5 overworld graphics, and more.
